ratnagiri.name: Ratnagiri Estate
ratnagiri.notes: Pioneering Bababudangiri estate celebrated for precision anaerobic, yeast-inoculated, and carbonic maceration micro-lots under multi-tier native shade.

riverdale.name: Riverdale Estate
riverdale.notes: High-altitude Eastern Ghats estate in Yercaud known for bright washed Arabicas and signature fermented naturals like the N72 lot.

kerehaklu.name: Kerehaklu Estate
kerehaklu.notes: Fifth-generation biodiversity-forward farm intercropping pepper and native timber, producing clean honey, washed, and natural lots.

baarbara.name: Baarbara Estate
baarbara.notes: Renowned Western Ghats estate producing fruit-forward berry naturals and honey-processed SLN 795 and Chandragiri micro-lots.

attikan.name: Attikan Estate
attikan.notes: High-elevation estate bordering the BRT Wildlife Sanctuary, famed for structured, cocoa-and-dried-fruit washed coffees.

salawara.name: Salawara Estate
salawara.notes: Rainforest-shaded Aldur estate producing syrupy honey and natural lots characterized by stone-fruit sweetness and tropical aromatics.

hoysala.name: Hoysala Estate
hoysala.notes: Chikmagalur specialty farm recognized for clean washed, honey, and experimental fermented Arabica harvests.

harley.name: Harley Estate
harley.notes: Historic 19th-century Manjarabad estate producing consistent washed, honey, and experimental Arabica alongside fine Robusta.

bale-thota.name: Bale Thota Estate
bale-thota.notes: Small-batch Chikmagalur estate cultivating shade-grown Arabica with emphasis on sweet, rounded washed and natural micro-lots.

thogarihunkal.name: Thogarihunkal Estate
thogarihunkal.notes: Heritage Bababudangiri estate producing balanced, spiced washed and pulped sun-dried Arabica lots.

krishnagiri.name: Krishnagiri Estate
krishnagiri.notes: Sister farm to Ratnagiri in the Bababudangiri hills, specializing in expressive natural and anaerobic SLN 795 and Chandragiri lots.

unakki.name: Unakki Estate
unakki.notes: High-slope Chikmagalur farm producing crisp washed and fruit-driven natural specialty lots.

yelnoorkhan.name: Yelnoorkhan Estate
yelnoorkhan.notes: Established Chikmagalur estate cultivating SLN 795 and Chandragiri under dense silver oak and native rainforest canopy.

mooleh-manay.name: Mooleh Manay Estate
mooleh-manay.notes: Biodiverse Kodagu estate prized for syrupy honey, red honey, and classic washed Arabica lots.

moganad.name: Moganad Estate
moganad.notes: High-elevation Yercaud estate yielding crisp citrus-and-floral washed coffees and vibrant honey lots.

orchadale.name: Orchadale Estate
orchadale.notes: Cool-climate Shevaroy Hills plantation noted for clean acidity, sweet citrus aromatics, and refined washed Arabicas.

ms-estate.name: M.S. Estate
ms-estate.notes: High-elevation Bababudangiri estate producing complex experimental naturals, honey lots, and crisp washed coffees.

sampigehoney.name: Sampigehoney Estate
sampigehoney.notes: Chikmagalur farm known for aromatic, honey-sweet washed and natural lots named after native magnolia blossoms.

elkhill.name: Elkhill Estate
elkhill.notes: Well-known Kodagu estate producing full-bodied washed Arabica and specialty fine Robusta under dense spice-intercropped shade.

punjisil.name: Punjisil Estate
punjisil.notes: Emerging Eastern Ghats origin in Koraput producing clean, sweet washed and natural micro-lots with vibrant stone-fruit character.
